say: In this first episode, you'll run QualityRag on your own machine and check your first answer, in about four minutes.
Most retrieval systems work the same way.
They search your documents, hand the top passages to a language model, and the model answers.
It answers even when the passages don't really support it, like an old runbook that predates today's controls.
QualityRag adds a check before the answer.
Your policy lists what an answer needs.
For each requirement, the check counts independent sources, and rejects evidence that is too old or contradicted.
The result is one of three: supported, not enough evidence, or contradicted.
Copies of the same document count once, so a mirrored handbook is still one source.
And conditional words, like unless, or only, are highlighted. The check counts the passage, but it does not read the condition. A person should.
Clone the repository, and install the requirements.
The bootstrap command creates local keys, and a sign in token that lasts twenty four hours.
Then start the console, and open it in your browser.

steps.say: Paste the token from browser token dot text, and open your workspace.
Home shows what needs your attention. The engine panel below lists every part of the machinery, read live from the server.
Open, check an answer. Sample data loads by itself, so you can try everything before bringing your own documents.
The checklist shows the passages your search returned. The requirements show what the answer needs.
The answer is supported. But read the line beside it: two requirements rely on conditional wording, and all three rest on a single source.
Select a requirement, to see exactly which passages were counted.
Here, the word unless is highlighted. The passage counts, but the condition needs a human reader.
And for the recovery procedure, the mirrored copy of the handbook is counted once, not twice.
Now untick the memo about the emergency exception, and check again.
One requirement has lost its only source, so the result becomes, not enough evidence.
That is the core idea. The result follows the evidence, not the model's confidence.
It lists what the check cannot see on its own, with a fix for each one. We'll work through them in episode two.

say: You've installed QualityRag, signed in, and checked your first answer.
Next time: fixing what health finds.
